title: ZDI publishes DeepSpeed _get_zero_stage deserialization RCE flaw (ZDI-26-1065) as a 0-day advisory
date_note: Date is ZDI's coordinated public release day of the advisory.
summary: Zero Day Initiative's advisory ZDI-26-1065 describes a deserialization of untrusted data remote code execution flaw in DeepSpeed's _get_zero_stage, scored CVSS 7.8. ZDI says it reported the bug to the vendor on 7 May 2026 and notified its intent to publish it as a 0-day advisory on 19 November. The page says exploitation requires the target to visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
plain: ZDI published details of a code-execution flaw in the DeepSpeed software. Exploiting it requires the target to visit a malicious page or open a malicious file, according to ZDI.
exec: ZDI rates the DeepSpeed flaw CVSS 7.8 and published it as a 0-day advisory after reporting it to the vendor on 7 May 2026.
action: ZDI advises that the only salient mitigation is to restrict interaction with the product; the page records no vendor reply.

validation.note: Only ZDI's own advisory was read; the page does not say whether the maintainers responded or patched.

review.note: Compared CVE, CVSS 7.8, 7 May report, 19 Nov intent, mitigation and UI requirement with ZDI page
